recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a narrow horizontal letterbox strip revealing a close-up of human eyes illuminated in intense red light, set against a stark, textured white field with stacked typography above.
coreVisualRelationships: The red-lit eyes act as the primary emotional anchor against the neutral white void.
The sharp horizontal crop of the eyes contrasts with the vertical drip of the secondary text.
The hierarchy moves from the top-aligned text down to the central eye-strip, then to the bottom metadata.
coreInvariants: Horizontal black letterbox strip with soft feathered edges.
Monochromatic red lighting within the eye-strip.
Pure white textured background for the negative space.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A narrow horizontal band centered vertically, occupying approximately 25% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pupils of the eyes, centered within the horizontal strip.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow: Title text -> Eye strip -> Bottom advisory label.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space above and below the central strip, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crimson Red (Internal eye lighting and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value white background vs. low value, high saturation red focal point.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Bold, condensed industrial sans-serif with slight grit.
Secondary text: Aggressive, hand-drawn brush style with sharp terminals and vertical paint drips.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical paint drips extending from the baseline of the secondary text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Industrial sans-serif paired with chaotic, expressive hand-lettering.

avoid: Script fonts that are too clean or cursive

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy industrial feel of the primary text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Road Rage or Horror-style brush script
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, dripping aesthetic of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured white background. In the center, place a narrow horizontal black strip with soft, feathered edges. Inside the strip, show a close-up of human eyes looking directly forward, illuminated entirely by a harsh, saturated red light source, leaving the rest of the face in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of text at the top center. The top line should be a bold, black condensed sans-serif. The bottom line should be a larger, aggressive red brush-style script with vertical paint drips falling from the letters.

verificationChecks: Is the red lighting inside the strip highly saturated?
Do the paint drips look organic and vertical?
Is the background a clean, textured white?

adjustableVariables: Length and frequency of the paint drips
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The specific parental advisory badge layout

mustAchieve: High contrast between the white void and the dark strip
Intense, emotive gaze in the eyes

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eyes are the only part of the face visible.
Check that the red color does not bleed into the white background.
Confirm the text is centered and follows the hierarchy.
Verify the letterbox edges are softly feathered, not sharp lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central horizontal crop + monochromatic focal lighting + high-contrast negative space + mixed industrial/expressive typography.
